high_level_description: This image captures a vibrant urban scene at dusk or early evening. The setting is a riverside area with a prominent building in the background that resembles the Wrigley Building in Chicago, characterized by its distinctive architecture with ornate details and multiple levels of windows. In the foreground, there is a woman standing on a bridge or walkway overlooking the river. She is dressed in a white, knee-length dress and has long, dark hair. She is smiling and appears to be enjoying the view, with one hand resting on the railing and the other touching her hair.
